subtitle.en: 108 names of Bhatuka Bhairava, the swift-acting child form of Bhairava

source.en: Recited in the worship of Bhatuka Bhairava, especially on Bhairava Jayanti, on Chaturdashi tithis and Sundays, and along with the Bhairava mula mantra japa
source.te: భైరవ జయంతి, చతుర్దశి తిథులు, ఆదివారాలలో మరియు భైరవ మూల మంత్ర జపంతో పాటు భటుక భైరవ పూజలో పఠిస్తారు

benefit.en: Bhatuka Bhairava is worshipped as the quick-acting child form of Bhairava; chanting his 108 names is believed to remove fear, evil forces and obstacles and to grant swift protection.
benefit.te: భటుక భైరవుడు త్వరితఫల ప్రదాయకుడైన భైరవ బాల స్వరూపం; ఈ 108 నామాలను పఠిస్తే భయం, దుష్టశక్తులు, విఘ్నాలు తొలగి శీఘ్ర రక్షణ ప్రాప్తిస్తుందని నమ్ముతారు.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the fierce and protective form of Shiva, Lord Bhairava.
items.mean_te: ఉగ్రుడు రక్షకుడు అయిన శివ స్వరూపుడైన శ్రీ భైరవునికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the lord of all beings and elemental spirits.
Salutations to the indwelling self of all creatures.
items.mean_te: సర్వ ప్రాణులలో ఆత్మగా వెలుగుతున్న వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who nourishes and protects every being.
items.mean_te: సమస్త భూతాలను పోషించి రక్షించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the bestower of the sacred kshetra, the field of merit.
Salutations to the guardian of the holy kshetra.
Salutations to the knower of the field, the all-knowing one.
Salutations to the one of valiant warrior nature.
Salutations to the resplendent one who shines untainted.
Salutations to the one who dwells in the cremation ground.
Salutations to the fierce one who accepts the tantric offerings of the cremation rites.
items.mean_te: తాంత్రిక పూజలలో నైవేద్యం స్వీకరించే ఉగ్ర స్వరూపునికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who receives offerings in the skull-bowl.
Salutations to the one who brought the sacrifice of the wicked to its end.
Salutations to the fierce Lord who accepts the blood offering.
items.mean_te: రక్త నైవేద్యం స్వీకరించే ఉగ్ర మూర్తికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who holds sway over the life-breath of all.
items.mean_te: సర్వ ప్రాణుల ప్రాణాలపై అధిపత్యం కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one ever accomplished in all powers.
Salutations to the bestower of spiritual attainments.
Salutations to the one worshipped by the perfected siddhas.
Salutations to the awe-inspiring one with the fearsome face.
items.mean_te: భయంకరమైన కరాల వదనం కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who quells even death, the lord of time.
Salutations to the one whose body is firm as a piece of wood, unmoved by anything.
items.mean_te: కలాకాష్ఠం వంటి స్థిర దేహం కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the wise seer and poet.
Salutations to the three-eyed one.
Salutations to the many-eyed one who sees everything.
items.mean_te: అనేక కళ్లతో సర్వాన్ని చూసే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one with tawny, glowing eyes.
items.mean_te: పింగల వర్ణపు కళ్లు కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the wielder of the trident.
Salutations to the wielder of the sword.
Salutations to the one adorned with bones.
Salutations to the one whose eyes are dark as smoke.
Salutations to the fearless one who grants fearlessness.
items.mean_te: భయం లేని అభయము ప్రసాదించు వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations again to the fierce Lord Bhairava.
Salutations to the lord of Bhairavi.
Salutations to the protector and ruler of all beings.
Salutations to the lord of the yoginis.
Salutations to the giver of wealth.
Salutations to the one who takes away the wealth of the wicked.
Salutations to the protector of the wealth of devotees.
Salutations to the one radiant with insight and glory.
Salutations to the one who wears serpents as a garland.
Salutations to the one whose matted locks are entwined with serpents.
Salutations to the one whose crown of hair is the vast sky.
Salutations to the bearer of the skull-bowl.
Salutations to time itself, the lord of death.
Salutations to the wearer of the garland of skulls.
Salutations to the one lovely and dear to devotees.
Salutations to the treasure-house of the arts.
Salutations to the three-eyed Lord.
Salutations to the one with blazing eyes.
Salutations to the one with three tufts of hair on his crest.
items.mean_te: తలపై మూడు శిఖలు కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the upholder of the three worlds.
Salutations to the one with three-fold eyes.
Salutations to the child form of the Lord.
Salutations to the peaceful one.
Salutations to the one dear to the peaceful and the saintly.
Salutations to the boy-form (vatuka) of Bhairava.
Salutations to the lord of the vatuka attendants.
Salutations to the wielder of the khatvanga and the bestower of boons.
items.mean_te: చేతిలో ఖట్వాంగం ధరించి వరాలు ప్రసాదించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the overseer of all beings.
items.mean_te: సమస్త భూతగణాలకు అధికారి అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the lord of all living beings.
Salutations to the divine mendicant who seeks alms.
items.mean_te: భిక్షాటన చేసే దివ్య సన్యాసి స్వరూపునికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the humble attendant form of the Lord.
Salutations to the crafty one who outwits evildoers.
Salutations to the sky-clad one.
Salutations to the valorous lord.
Salutations to the lion-like one, fearless and majestic.
Salutations to the one with pale, glowing eyes.
items.mean_te: పాండుర వర్ణ కళ్లు కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the supremely calm one.
Salutations to the bestower of peace.
Salutations to the perfectly pure one.
Salutations to the dear kinsman of Shankara himself.
Salutations to the one of eight cosmic forms.
Salutations to the lord of treasures.
Salutations to the one who sees through the eye of wisdom.
Salutations to the embodiment of tamas, the dark power of dissolution.
Salutations to the one who bears the eight supports.
Salutations to the one who bears all the divine kalas.
Salutations to the one adorned with serpents.
Salutations to the one who bears the hare-marked moon on his crest.
Salutations to the one who bears the earth.
Salutations to the lord of the mountains.
Salutations to the lord of the earth.
Salutations to the one whose self is the mountain.
Salutations to the bearer of the skeleton.
Salutations to the one who bears the mundi, the severed head.
Salutations to the one who wears the serpent as his sacred thread.
Salutations to the one whose power makes all forces tremble.
items.mean_te: సర్వ శక్తులను వణికించే జృంభణ శక్తి కలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one with the power to captivate.
Salutations to the one with the power to paralyze.
Salutations to the wielder of the power of destruction over evil.
Salutations to the one with the power to shake and agitate.
Salutations to the one whose body shines like pure black collyrium.
items.mean_te: శుద్ధమైన నీలాంజనం వంటి దేహం కలిగిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one adorned with the garland of severed heads.
Salutations to the one who accepts the bali offerings.
Salutations to the one who abides as the bali offering itself.
Salutations to the beloved one of captivating beauty.
Salutations to the one of wondrous valor who fulfills desires.
Salutations to the one who rescues from every calamity.
items.mean_te: సర్వ ఆపదల నుండి రక్షించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the impregnable one, hard to approach or assail.
Salutations to the one attended by fierce and wicked beings.
Salutations again to the beloved, captivating Lord.
Salutations again to the treasury of arts and grace.
Salutations to the radiant one of matchless charm.
Salutations to the one who brings all the lovely ones under his sway.
items.mean_te: మనోహరులను వశం చేసే శక్తి కలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one with the power of complete control.
Salutations to the bestower of all attainments.
Salutations to the divine physician who heals all ills.
items.mean_te: సమస్త రోగాలను నయం చేసే దివ్య వైద్యునికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the almighty one whose influence pervades everywhere.
Salutations to the one of supreme glory and power.
